name: Electric Chain Hoist
desc: Three-phase electric chain hoist built for heavy-industry lifting, available in single or dual speed. The premium aluminium-alloy body dissipates heat and withstands repeated lifting cycles, while a friction-clutch overload limiter, upper and lower over-travel limit switches, induction-hardened oil-bath gearing and an instant magnetic brake keep operation safe and quiet. Ultra-hardened Grade 80 load chain (Japan-made) and a German-made control switch. Standard lifting height 3–12 m. An electric-trolley version (ECHKT) is available for travel along the beam. Conforms to and tested per EN 13157:2004+A1:2009 and AS 1418.2.
